QuestInfo.name: [FriendStory] How Did You Get So Close
QuestInfo.0: Francis is happy with the picture of Orchid, but Oz looks like she has a question. Speak to Oz.
QuestInfo.1: Everyone is curious how you got so close to Orchid. Tell them what happened.
QuestInfo.2: After hearing about Orchid's emotional scars, Francis wants to confess his love for her to ease her loneliness.
